imperfections.name: Metal Type Edge Bite
imperfections.mechanism: Heavy cylinder letterpress pressure squashes viscous black ink outwards around letterform perimeters.

imperfections.name: Film-Stripping Register Drift
imperfections.mechanism: Secondary spot red plate misaligns slightly from the black structural grid.

imperfections.name: Silkscreen Squeegee Mesh Drag
imperfections.mechanism: Manual rubber squeegee pressure pulls liquid acrylic pigment across mesh threads, leaving subtle edge drag lines and ink bead ridges.

imperfections.name: Hand-Pulled Screen Misregistration
imperfections.mechanism: Wood screen frames shift slightly on table hinges, causing 1.5mm to 3mm registration gaps and accidental fluorescent overprint overlaps.

imperfections.name: Risograph Rubber Roller Drag
imperfections.mechanism: Friction paper feed wheels leave faint longitudinal carbon/pink pickup tracks along central axis.

imperfections.name: High-Speed Drum Misregistration
imperfections.mechanism: Successive drum passes rotate and shift mechanically by up to 3mm, revealing raw paper gaps and overprint overlaps.
imperfections.range: 1.0mm to 3.0mm translational shift, 0.5 to 1.5 deg rotational tilt

imperfections.name: Wood Plank Grain Voids
imperfections.mechanism: Coarse pearwood grain absorbs less ink in annular rings, leaving white striations across large black/red solids.

imperfections.name: Letterpress Roller Ink Starvation
imperfections.mechanism: Hand brayer roller exhausts ink towards the bottom of massive display letters, causing dry-brush stipple.
imperfections.range: density falls from 100% to 75% at baseline

imperfections.name: Offset Litho Matrix Dot Gain
imperfections.mechanism: High-pressure offset cylinder slightly expands matrix grid dots by 4% on cast-coated board.

imperfections.name: Crouwel 45-Degree Plate Misregistration
imperfections.mechanism: Secondary flame vermilion plate shifts 0.4mm along the 45-degree isometric vector.

imperfections.name: Thermal Element Burnout Line
imperfections.mechanism: A single failed thermal resistor dot on the print head leaves a continuous blank white hairline along paper feed direction.

imperfections.name: Fax Stepper Motor Feed Jitter
imperfections.mechanism: Rubber platen roller slips momentarily, compressing or expanding horizontal scanline pitch by 15%.

imperfections.name: Copperplate Embossed Border Indentation
imperfections.mechanism: Intense rolling-press pressure forces the beveled metal plate edge into damp rag paper, creating a debossed groove.

imperfections.name: Artisan Watercolor Wash Overspill
imperfections.mechanism: Hand-applied botanical tint washes slightly exceed the engraved copperplate contour line.

imperfections.name: Photocopier Drum Longitudinal Scratch
imperfections.mechanism: Scratched OPC photosensitive drum deposits a persistent faint vertical black toner hairline from top to bottom.

imperfections.name: Manual Flatbed Document Feed Skew
imperfections.mechanism: Original paste-up sheet laid by hand on scanner glass at a hasty 1.5-degree angle.

imperfections.name: Letterpress Roller Ink Bleed
imperfections.mechanism: Heavy oil-based primary inks squash slightly past the metal type rules under heavy platen impression onto fibrous pressboard.

imperfections.name: Platen Impression Indentation
imperfections.mechanism: Hard typographic blocks leave visible physical deboss impression in unbleached structural pressboard fibers.

imperfections.name: Technical Pen Dwell Dots
imperfections.mechanism: Drafting pen momentarily pauses before lifting at vector vertices, leaving a tiny saturated capillary ink bead.
imperfections.range: 0.4mm to 0.8mm circular dwell bead at vector joints

imperfections.name: Draftsman Ruler Under-Edge Smudge
imperfections.mechanism: Wet ink creeps under the bevel of an acrylic drafting triangle when moved too quickly across vellum.
imperfections.range: subtle friction smear along 1 rule segment
